name: hud_ui_save_load_dialog_destructor
description: HudUiSaveLoadDialog::Destructor frees the save-file entry vector, destroys the list item panels and owned dialog widgets, then tears down the HudUiBackground base.
known_limits: Tier C only; Binary Ninja shows MSVC SEH scaffolding around the destructor, and tier S comparison is deferred to the Save/Load dialog class cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4349a0 validates operator delete on fileEntries.begin, clearing begin/end/capacityEnd, array destruction of nine entryWidgets through HudUiPanel::DestructorThunk, destruction of gameNameInput, prev/next/back/delete widgets, and final HudUiBackground::Destructor.

The native smoke constructs the owned Save/Load dialog members, allocates the file entry vector, invokes the destructor, and verifies vector clearing plus entry panel, game-name input, and button teardown state.
